business_problem: Centralization needed to manage global sales growth Lenovo recognized the immense potential to expand its business from hardware sales to a portfolio of smart IoT, Smart Infrastructure, and Smart Verticals through its three business groups, IDG, ISG and Lenovo Solutions and Services Group (SSG).
solution_summary: Lenovo, a Manufacturing organization in China, modernized this customer service automation workload with Dynamics 365 Sales, Power BI, Microsoft Copilot for Sales, and Power Platform. Centralization needed to manage global sales growth Lenovo recognized the immense potential to expand its business from hardware sales to a portfolio of smart IoT, Smart Infrastructure, and Smart Verticals through its three business groups, IDG, ISG and Lenovo Solutions and Services Group (SSG). Dynamics 365 Sales gives sales teams a unified CRM system for pipeline management, guidance, and forecasting. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Microsoft Copilot for Sales brings AI-assisted sales guidance and content generation into sellers’ existing workflows. Lenovo sales team transforms globally and closes faster with Dynamics 365 Sales.
